title: bromus madritensis subsp. rubens
intro: Bromus madritensis subsp. rubens, commonly known as Spanish Brome, is a perennial grass native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and alleviating respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Spanish Brome include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Bromus madritensis subsp. rubens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
